levels.surface: عبد الله بن عبيد بن عمير
عبد الله بن عبيد بن عمير

notes: The gloss «عبد الكريم يرفعه إلى ابن عباس وهارون لم يرفعه» is an editor's gloss: it is not written as a route, but it explains why the two routes differ at the end
«وعبد الكريم» replaces Harun as the second route's transmitter, so the two routes are written in full (no shared tail)
«قالا جاء رجل» is the convergence on the saying, which carries no names; «غيره» is an unnamed co-transmitter (rule 8)
